content.thinking: The dictionary expects codes space-padded to 8 characters, but I'm seeing lengths of 4 and 5, likely due to blank-padding behavior on the character type. I'll check the declared column widths and run integrity checks across the tables.

input.sql: SELECT table_name, column_name, data_type, character_maximum_length, numeric_precision, numeric_scale, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND (data_type IN ('character','numeric') ) ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'jrnl_unbalanced' k, count(*) c FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum("DR_AMT")<>sum("CR_AMT")) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_no_header', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'hdr_no_lines', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_bad_acct', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" a WHERE a."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_bad_acct_trim', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" a WHERE trim(a."ACCT_CD")=trim(l."ACCT_CD"))
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_bad_vend', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APVEND" v WHERE v."VEND_CD"=i."VEND_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_bad_jrnl', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_null_jrnl', count(*) FROM "APINVH" WHERE "JRNL_NO" IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_bad_inv', count(*) FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'hdr_bad_prd', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLPERD" p WHERE p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'hdr_date_outside_prd', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."POST_DT"<p."STRT_DT" OR h."POST_DT">p."END_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'hdr_post_after_close', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE p."CLOSE_DT" IS NOT NULL AND h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_amts', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT"<0 OR "CR_AMT"<0
UNION ALL SELECT 'both_dr_cr', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT"<>0 AND "CR_AMT"<>0
UNION ALL SELECT 'null_amts', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT" IS NULL OR "CR_AMT" IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'paid_no_pay', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE "STAT_CD"='P' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'open_with_pay', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE "STAT_CD"='O' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_ne_inv', count(*) FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i ON i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" WHERE p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'multi_pay_inv', count(*) FROM (SELECT "INV_ID" FROM "APPAYM" GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_inv_no', count(*) FROM (SELECT "VEND_CD","INV_NO" FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1) x
